description: Create a tracked short link for a URL. It comes with its own QR code (same id; use download_qr). Supports a custom slug and a custom domain. The destination can be changed later with update_short_link, and clicks are tracked. Never shorten a link that is already a Hovercode short link, form link, or page link — those are already tracked and already have a QR code.

display_name.description: Internal name to find this link later.

domain.description: Custom short-link domain; else a default is used.

gps.description: Prompt visitors to share their location.

tags.description: Labels to attach (created if new) so you can find these later — list_qr_codes and list_short_links search by tag.

workspace.description: Workspace id. Optional when the account has one workspace; use list_workspaces to resolve otherwise.

name: create_short_link

error.description: Present only when the tool failed (the result is also flagged isError).

cause.description: Machine-readable failure category: invalid_argument, not_found, forbidden, plan_limit, rate_limited, or server_error.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same call could succeed.

svg.description: QR code for the short URL, as SVG markup.
